description: Counts and totals for US tax-exempt organizations from IRS public data: national, one state, or one NTEE major category (A-Z). Active organizations, 990-N filers, revocations, and revenue, assets, employees and pay from e-filed returns; national adds e-Postcard filers by year, revocations by month and organizations by category.

ntee_major.description: With scope "ntee": NTEE major group letter, e.g. B (education)
